d: In this video, Firstpost explains how scientists are investigating a possible link between microplastics and changing ocean colour near the Great Pacific Garbage Patch. Satellite data revealed blue and green brightening in the Pacific. In simulations, cyan-coloured brightening rose from 3% to 13% when microplastics were included. Does this mean plastic pollution is changing the colour of our oceans? Not yet: researchers say the findings are not proof, and more direct measurements are needed.
